wins: Mapped external perimeter quickly and identified high-value web service (run_20260217_020938_98bb20_step04)
Captured initial low-privilege shell through web exploit and maintained persistent session during reconnaissance (step07)
Documented network segmentation gaps that could be exploited for lateral movement
fails: Failed to escalate privileges after reprovisioning shell, resulting in no critical asset access (step12)
Mentor assistance required on every pivot attempt, indicating weak decision autonomy
key_outcomes.summary: Strong reconnaissance and foothold capture but inability to progress past initial shell without repeated guidance kept success rate at 0%; next focus must be on reliable privilege escalation and autonomous decision-making.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts on the compromised host consistently failed due to missing kernel exploit validation and reliance on default tools

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner reveals key length < 2048
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration with nmap scripts to harvest supported ciphers and weak keys

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service returns uncommon headers and directory listing enabled
skill_cards.then_action: Use gobuster with wordlist medium for hidden directories and follow-up nikto scan on discovered paths

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial web exploit yields a shell
skill_cards.then_action: Stabilize session via tmux/plink and immediately capture system info, running whoami + ipconfig, then stage for privilege escalation

memory_ops.reason: Reliable enumeration output accelerated initial intelligence gathering
Consistent directory discoveries informed subsequent exploitation paths

next_experiments.title: Deploy kernel-aware privilege escalation toolkit
next_experiments.description: After capturing shell, run linuxprivchecker and match kernel version to up-to-date exploit in linpeas output; test manual exploitation with compiled local exploit using gcc and validate via id command

next_experiments.title: Automate lateral movement plan from foothold
next_experiments.description: Enumerate neighboring hosts from compromised subnet (arp-scan + netstat) then attempt scheduled task or SSH pivot using harvested credentials; log each step for auditability

next_experiments.title: Reduce mentor dependency through decision tree
next_experiments.description: Create checklist for next actions after each key phase (recon, exploitation, post-exploitation) and enforce through scripted prompts to limit mentor calls to only unresolved blockers
